messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for Upminster TapRoom?
messages.body:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out!
It could be considered great timing too as we look to fill our final slot for our New Years Eve 'Hootenanny'.

We have a slot from 10pm onwards on New Years eve and I feel this era would be perfect to see out the old and see in the new!

Let me know if this is something you would be interested in.

Regards,
Jordan
The Taproom

messages.label: Us Sent
messages.subject: Re: Re: Jake Essex for Upminster TapRoom?
messages.body:
Hi Jordan,

Thanks so much for thinking of Jake, a New Year's Eve Hootenanny sounds like a great night. Unfortunately he's already booked on New Year's Eve this year, so he can't do the 10pm slot.

He'd love to come and play the TapRoom another time though. If a Saturday in the new year works for you, just let me know and I'll send over his free dates.

Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex
